description_en: Modifies the log backup retention policy for a PolarDB cluster
description_zh: 修改PolarDB集群的日志备份保留策略
name: ModifyLogBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to view information about all clusters in a specific region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看目标地域下所有的集群信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The retention period of log backups. Valid values:

3 to 7300: The retention period in days.

-1: long-term retention.

* After you enable the advanced backup feature, this parameter is no longer valid. Use the AdvancedLogPolicies parameter instead
parameters.help_zh:
日志保留周期，取值范围如下：
3～7300：日志保留周期，单位为天。
-1：长期保留。

* 开启高级备份后，该参数不再生效，请使用参数 AdvancedLogPolicies
parameters.name: log_backup_retention_period

parameters.help_en:
The destination region for cross-region log backups. For information about the regions that support cross-region backup, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html.

- After you enable the advanced backup feature, this parameter is no longer valid. Use the AdvancedLogPolicies parameter instead
parameters.help_zh:
日志备份跨地域备份区域。跨地域备份支持的地域请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72672.html。
* 开启高级备份后，该参数不再生效，请使用参数 AdvancedLogPolicies
parameters.name: log_backup_another_region_region

parameters.help_en:
The retention period of cross-region log backups. Valid values:

0: Disables the cross-region log backup feature.

30 to 7300: The retention period in days.

-1: long-term retention.

* When you create a cluster, the default value of this parameter is 0. This value disables the cross-region log backup feature.

- After you enable the advanced backup feature, this parameter is no longer valid. Use the AdvancedLogPolicies parameter instead
parameters.help_zh:
日志备份跨地域备份保留周期。取值范围如下：

0：关闭日志备份跨地域备份功能。
30～7300：日志备份跨地域备份保留周期，单位为天。
-1：长期保留。

* 创建集群时，默认取值为0，即关闭日志备份跨地域备份功能。
* 开启高级备份后，该参数不再生效，请使用参数 AdvancedLogPolicies
parameters.name: log_backup_another_region_retention_period

fields.help_en:
The operation type. Valid values:

CREATE: Create

UPDATE: Update

DELETE: Delete
fields.help_zh:
操作类型，取值如下：
CREATE：新增
UPDATE：更新
DELETE：删除
fields.name: action_type

fields.help_en: The destination region of the log backup policy
fields.help_zh: 日志备份策略目标地域
fields.name: dest_region

fields.help_en:
The destination type of the backup policy. Valid values:

level1: level-1 backup

level2: level-2 backup

level2Cross: level-2 cross-region backup
fields.help_zh:
备份策略目标类型，取值如下：
level1：一级备份
level2：二级备份
level2Cross：二级跨地域备份
fields.name: dest_type

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable log backup. Set the value to 1
fields.help_zh: 是否开启日志备份，固定为 1
fields.name: enable_log_backup

fields.help_en:
The retention period type for log backups. Valid values:

never: The backups never expire.

delay: The backups expire after a fixed number of days
fields.help_zh:
日志备份保留周期类型，取值如下：

never：永不过期
delay：固定天数过期
fields.name: log_retention_type

fields.help_en:
The number of days to retain the log backups. Valid values:

3 to 7300: The retention period in days.

-1: long-term retention
fields.help_zh:
日志备份保留天数，取值范围如下：
3～7300：日志保留周期，单位为天。
-1：长期保留
fields.name: log_retention_value

fields.help_en: The ID of the log backup policy
fields.name: policy_id

fields.help_en: The source region of the log backup policy
fields.name: src_region

fields.help_en:
The source type of the log backup policy. Valid values:

db: database cluster

level1: level-1 backup

level2: level-2 backup

level2Cross: level-2 cross-region backup
fields.help_zh:
日志备份策略源类型，取值如下：

db：数据库集群
level1：一级备份
level2：二级备份
level2Cross：二级跨地域备份
fields.name: src_type

parameters.help_en:
The advanced backup policies.

- This parameter is not supported for PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Oracle Compatible) or PolarDB for PostgreSQL.

- This parameter is supported only for clusters for which the BackupPolicyLevel parameter is set to Advanced
parameters.help_zh:
高级备份策略。
* PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）、PolarDB PostgreSQL版不支持该参数。
* 仅 BackupPolicyLevel 为 Advanced 的集群支持该参数
parameters.name: advanced_log_policies
